step: E0 task 1 -- string support label on generator-visible text

meta.git_worktree_note: working tree has uncommitted edits to other files; pipeline modules used here were imported unmodified and patched in memory only

label_definitions.old_fulltext: metrics.gold_in_text(gold, full stored corpus text), any of the shown docs
label_definitions.new_visible600: metrics.gold_in_text(gold, text[:600]), any of the shown docs; text[:600] is exactly the per-passage prefix every generator rendered (DOC_CHARS=600); same SQuAD normalisation

support_interaction.py.compared: entire output JSON (string and nli labels)

masked_counterfactual.py.compared: support_interaction_masked['string'] and its unsupported-cost slope (the only label-dependent block; recomputed with the script's own loaders and interaction_ci)

routing_baselines.py.compared: policies.gold_string, vs_reference.gold_string, reference, perq_best mean (label-dependent entries; recomputed with the script's own estimators)

support_interaction_unmasked_hybrid.label: string
support_interaction_unmasked_hybrid.weighting: QUESTION-POOLED: gain(S) and gain(U) are means over all questions in each arm, every question weight 1. CI: quiz-cluster bootstrap (resample quizzes with replacement, both arms recomputed per draw, percentile interval). Not quiz-weighted. Haiku (bare generations/) is not in this script's model glob.

masked_hybrid_support_interaction.label: string
masked_hybrid_support_interaction.slice: Static only, as in the script
masked_hybrid_support_interaction.weighting: QUESTION-POOLED arm means (the script's quiz-weighted primary applies to its paired mask deltas, NOT to this support interaction); quiz-cluster bootstrap CI. Haiku is included (key '' = Haiku).

support_conditioned.label: string
support_conditioned.no_interaction_estimand: this script has no gain(S)-gain(U) interaction; the side-by-side fields are its own quantities

weighting.acc_given_support / acc_given_no_support: QUIZ-WEIGHTED: mean of per-quiz accuracy over quizzes having >=1 question in that arm; CI = i.i.d. bootstrap over those quiz means; field n = number of quizzes
weighting.paired_gain_given_support: QUESTION-POOLED mean of 100*(correct_RAG - correct_CB) over supported questions; CI = i.i.d. QUESTION bootstrap (NOT quiz-clustered); n = questions

routing_gold_string.weighting: QUIZ-WEIGHTED: policy mean = mean of per-quiz means over 199 quizzes; paired delta vs the better fixed policy is also a mean of quiz-mean differences; CI = bootstrap over quiz means. Ceiling (perq_best) does not depend on the label.

k_ablation_k3_k5.label: string
k_ablation_k3_k5.weighting: QUESTION-POOLED arm means; quiz-cluster bootstrap CI. Support is computed from the ranking file's doc lists (identical to the generation doc_ids for k3/k5).
k_ablation_k3_k5.k10: NOT REPORTED: 639/878 (72.8%) k=10 prompts exceeded the 1,536-token limit in local_generate.py and were right-truncated, removing the question; the arm is invalid pending a rerun.

not_causal: Support remains a gold-conditioned, non-randomised partition; these are descriptive associations.
